name: Learn to climb a rope
blurb: The gym-class skill most adults never got. With the right foot lock, a rope climb is far more about technique than upper-body strength.
gear: A climbing rope with safe landing beneath
steps: Build the base: hangs, then a few strict pull-ups, plus grip endurance.
Learn the J-hook or S-wrap foot lock, which lets your legs take most of the weight — this is the whole skill.
Practise locking and unlocking the feet while seated on the floor with the rope.
Do a low climb: lock feet, stand up on the lock, reach up, re-lock, repeat.
Practise the descent, which is where rope burns happen: controlled, hand over hand, feet still gripping.
Build height gradually and never let go at the top.
tips: Climbing with arms alone will exhaust you in two metres. The legs are the engine.
Cover your shins. Rope burn there is memorable.
Never climb higher than you are willing to descend under control.
proof: A full climb using a foot lock and a controlled descent, twice in one session.
